spanish: Y el cinturón de su efodadura que sobre él, desde él él, como su obra: oro, azul y púrpura y carmesí y lino fino retorcido, conforme a lo que mandó Jehová a Moisés.

findings.issue: Common noun is coined as efodadura; -adura adds a made-work sense the feminine noun does not license.
Preposition suffix is 1st person common plural; Spanish uses 3rd person masculine singular.
Construct worm + scarlet is reduced to the color; the worm is omitted.
Lemma 8336 b is linen while the morphology tag is cardinal; Spanish takes only the linen sense.

notes: Jehová, Moisés, the conjunction pattern, and como su obra match the remaining tokens.
